notes.title: Speed, Progression, and Item Strategy Redesign
notes.content:
Matchy is not dead!

We've gotten a bunch of detailed critique and are starting another round of development. New things to come in the next build:
[list]
[*] [b]150 unique items[/b] - Instead of having a million versions of a top hat with slightly different stats that don't make much difference, each item will be unique, affecting the game in it's own way. Items themselves will upgrade as you progress based on how you play.
[*] [b]Redesigned the Speed System[/b] - Right now you can frantically move your pieces super fast, but that isn't as much fun as deciding thoughtfully where to move things based on optimizing your score and making it to the end of the levels. Now speed will be tied directly to how many pieces you can move, and each level will up the speed so that it is harder and harder to win, giving a sense of progression!
[*] [b]Progression is based on "runs" rather than unlocking "stars[/b] - Instead of getting 3 victory stars based on your score, the question will be how far you can get in each system. Once you've mastered one system you'll unlock the next one.
[*] [b]Randomization on each "run"[/b] New system with random seeds as well as both pre-designed and randomly generated levels, you'll get a bonus if you skip a level, but the speed goes up... risky and rewarding!  
[*] [b]Totally new shop system[/b] Beat the difficulty curve with crazy combos, permanant upgrades to your ships and items.
[*] [b]Unlock everything![/b] New screen to track which items you have unlocked, some ultra rare items may take some time to find, but it's worth it!
[/list]

notes.title: MatchyGotchyZ v0.38 - EA Update: Cards
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/9ad1f9d32f42b8d332871cae7e90005c0a770f84.png[/img]

Check out the latest update from the Matchyverse: Cards in MatchyGotchy Z.

We did a poll and we heard the biggest updates people wanted was more games so we are doing just that. Now you can play a game of Memory with your favorite Stars.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/773a03c19470659f7ece3c78b36fa7dc4aaec826.png[/img]

There are 3 different decks of cards, and each time you play you get a randomized set of icons to match, so have fun!

We also cleaned up a bit of the user interface. The full Build Logs are on our discord: [url=http://discord.silverwaregames.com]Silverware Games Discord[/url]

Also, we are featuring the Heart of the Matchyverse and our own Derpy Wasabi, Say here on the matchyverse blog: [url=https://matchyverse.com/index.php/2019/06/25/spotlight-on-say/]Spotlight on Say[/url]

We are hoping to build a community of citizens of the Matchyverse, so if you are excited about the games and want to have a say in the direction the universe goes in just join our streams on discord, Monday at 8pm EST and Friday at 9pm EST right here: [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/silverwaregames]Silverware Games Twitch[/url][/b] 

Thanks for being part of this adventure! 
-Michael - Matchyverse Cheesy Potato.

notes.title: ☆ Early Access Updates ☆
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/c127ef08a00eb032b79225350d8fa24d964b9a96.png[/img]

Henlo!

Happy to share that a new build goes up today and it features:

- Whole new sprite system which makes it easier for us to update the build. Had to reorganize over 200 sprites to make this work! It's optimization to make future updates easier.

- Important UI tweaks: different buttons / sliders, icons black out correctly.

Also, it includes:

- New music for Stardust, Zootlandia, and MatchyMart.

- New MatchyMart items. Introducing different cups for the cup game, each plays differently.

- And last but not least! New bug progression, each time you clean there are different bugs with different properties, including the BOSS BUG.

We will be showing the build via Twitch before it becomes available, that way we can show you all these things real time and hang out as we make the new build available.

Instead of making but chunks of updates every now and then, we figured we would make more frequent and smaller updates, and to keep up with this, we are scheduling live streams weekly during early access. This means, we hope to go live [b]every Monday at 8pm EST[/b] as we work and push new content as it goes!

[b]Feel free to join us tonight ～☆ https://www.twitch.tv/silverwaregames[/b]

-Say  ʕ•ᴥ•ʔﾉ♡ 


PS: We will also look forward to hang out with you every Friday with fun retro games we all love :)
